title: Perimeter Trail movement for node borders

request.text:
a muốn tạo thêm effect beam node như dạng này, thêm 1 setting movement motion để ra dc hiệu ứng như clip trên threads, và tương tự như Magnific khi nối Node
Clarification: Chỉ vệt sáng chạy quanh viền node

decision: Add Trail as an additional native Movement option; preserve accepted Orbit; two smooth arc-distance highlights share phase and color with inward light. No connector workflow.
result: Trail added to native Movement, deployed at https://nodeanimation.vercel.app/ version 1.4.0. Shared presets/default preserved. Exact Orbit regression and Trail export pixels passed.
checks: 9 focused Trail and handoff units passed; focused schema coverage passed
7 unique production-browser checks passed including Light/Dark geometry/seam, exact Orbit 1.3.1 pixels and Trail renderer/JSON parity
Canonical source boundary and TypeScript/Vite build passed
Live public entry and shared API verified; Light/Dark UI inspected
Protected feature loader fixed 20s deadline expired; no feature receipt or measured performance claimed
risks: Static Magnific reference does not establish a measured lap duration.
